title: Online Chess Reached 200 Million Beyond One TV Show
hook: Online chess kept growing long after one show sparked signups.
closing: The spike became a lasting habit, changing where millions learn and play.
question: Do you play online chess?

segments.say: Online chess reached 200 million members, nearly seven times its earlier base. The boom outlasted one release.
Online chess signups hit 2.8 million monthly after the show, nearly triple the baseline.
Online chess accounts represent about a third of 605 million regular players. Growth still has room.
